name: Knives
desc: While short and small, a knife is circumstantially deadlier than most due to its concealability.

stat.effects: When you Attack a Creature that does not Detect you, the Damage is more Vicious by T.

name: Sabers
desc: Light and deadly, a Saber is a precision tool.

stat.effects: When Attacking with a Saber, you can spend an additional AP to increase its Accuracy by 2.

name: Cleavers
desc: Intimidating, long, and eerily quick. Cleavers encourage one to weave through many foes at once.

stat.effects: Cleavers can inflict Rending Damage if your Body and their Bulk is greater than the Target's Weight. When Attacking, you can Maneuver for free.

name: Polearms
desc: Efficient and refined, Polearms are a widely spread group of Weapons, united by their superior range.

stat.effects: When Attacking, you can decrease its Accuracy by 2 to gain more Reach; you can also inflict a Bane on the same Attack to inflict Impaling Damage instead.

name: Axes
desc: Simple and brutal Weaponry, an Axe is intended to leverage a less accurate but cruel edge.

stat.effects: An Axe can inflict Rending Damage if its Bulk plus your Body is greater than the Weight of the Target. When Striking, you can delay the effect of the swing by a number of Turns, each Turn of delay increases the effective Weight by 2. Moving or losing effective Range with the Target negates the Strike.

name: Bludgeons
desc: While often crude in appearance, Bludgeons are designed to be highly effective tools against especially hard to crack foes.

stat.effects: Bludgeons Notch Objects (including Armor) twice as much, and deal Traumatic Damage if their Bulk is greater than the Target's. Their effective Weight for this purpose is increase by 6 by the Powerful Quality (this is multiplicative when they become more Powerful)

name: Bows
desc: The Bow is the prince of Weapons, able to deliver death at long distances with almost no delay. Though, it requires strength, precision, and dedicated training to use well.

stat.effects: If you Critically Fail a Ranged Attack with a Bow, it is Notched.

name: Arquebuses
desc: A modern Weapon, fit for the times. While less convenient, the elimination of tension and some skill makes these much easier to fire.

stat.effects: To Reload an Arquebus, you need Plugs in addition to the Bolt, but the Weapon's Tier is not subtracted from its Accuracy. Critically failing an Attack Notches the Weapon.
